title: Out-of-order GOP decode and reverse presentation

definition.title: Out-of-order GOP decode and reverse presentation
definition.source_excerpt: The four-second source was prepared as four independent one-second closed-GOP clips. They were decoded in deliberate non-timeline order 3 → 1 → 2 → 0. Each GOP retained exactly 30 ImageBitmaps, including an explicit initial-frame snapshot plus presentation callbacks. The retained frames were then drawn without further media seeking or decoding in global order 119 → 118 → ... → 0. All 120 frame identities were unique and strictly descending. Independent GOP encodes remained visually close to the matching full-source regions: sampled mean absolute RGB error was 0 to about 0.57/255. A separate stress probe started all four GOP media elements concurrently. Callback counts were 29, 29, 27 and 27 rather than 30 each. Therefore the useful result is bounded independent-region decode plus retained reverse presentation—not a claim that arbitrarily many decoder instances can run concurrently without loss.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
definition.minimum_probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse. definition.primary_metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
definition.scope_contract: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
definition.negative_control: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

prepare.basis: Implemented bounded independent-region decode/cache/reverse presentation for four12-frame closed H264 GOPs in one64x48source. ActualIDR NAL checks validate everyentry; non-RAP start13 rejects. Decodeorder3→1→2→0 retains exactly48 frames under221184visible-plane-byte cap; reverse delivery47→0 copies/hashes every fullI420 frame against independent fullhostdecode and draws tocanvas without further decode/seek. AllPTS/IDs are exact andframesclose. A separate boundedtwo-decoder schedule also retains all48; it does not erase historical four-native-capture stress losses. Actual sourceepoch replacement duringdecode discards12 oldframes, preserves12 exactnewsource-epoch outputs, and closesall24. Removing finalrequestedID47 makes completenessfail. This exact report key proposes a new bounded reverse-preview capability, not a concurrentdecode speedup; performance is not applicable and diagnosticwalltimes are not a benchmark. Tiny64x48, noB/openGOP, headlessdrawAPI rather than physicalscanout, nofullpreviewservice orproductionadmission claim.
